entities.summary:
TI-BASIC is the official name of several BASIC-like programming languages used by Texas Instruments' graphing calculators. It is a language family of three different and incompatible versions, released on different products:TI-BASIC 83 for TI-83 series, TI-84 Plus series
TI-BASIC 89 for TI-89 series, TI-92 series
TI-BASIC Nspire for TI Nspire series
